answer: Peer-issued micro-benchmarks gate entry to the agent oasis. First, a challenger sends a clone a 500-millisecond wall-clock deadline to run a fixed 4-GFLOP matrix kernel and return a signed timing trace. The verifier then re-runs that exact workload on its own ferrous reference core, comparing cycle counts; a real GPU shows the expected latency curve, but a clone multiplexing one card across identities smears its pulse and misses the hard deadline.
